subject: 2024 Election Results and Winter Community Events
overview: Host John Petrella reviewed the recent failure of a fire station proposal and the passage of two school overrides alongside a schedule of winter holiday events. The program also recognized local student-athletes and shared information on senior services and local fundraisers.

items.title: Election Results and Local Impact
items.summary: Petrella reported the failure of Question 6 regarding a new fire station and the narrow passage of Questions 7 and 8 regarding school overrides. He expressed concern that the election results reflected a divided city facing future tax increases.

items.title: Student and Professional Sports Recognitions
items.summary: The program honored numerous GBL All-Stars and MVPs from Medford High School and congratulated Medford native Joe Sacco on being named interim head coach of the Boston Bruins.

items.title: Library and Arts Community Events
items.summary: Petrella highlighted the Friends of the Library holiday book sale on December 7, the Library's eBay store, and a holiday shopping event at the Local Arts Collaborative. He also promoted the 'Books and Brews' event at Medford Brewing Company.

items.title: Charity and Senior Center Activities
items.summary: The Medford Police November food drive for non-perishable items continues until November 20 at the police station and Senior Center. The Senior Center also announced its Thanksgiving dinner, upcoming holiday party, and winter day trips.

items.title: Theater and Local Business Spotlights
items.summary: The segment detailed upcoming performances at Chevalier Theater and Deep Cuts, while spotlighting local vendors such as Four Good Vibes and the Medford Soap Company.

items.title: Mary Queen of Peace Christmas Stroll
items.summary: A vendor and holiday shopping event featuring over 30 vendors was announced for November 23 at St. Joseph's Church.
